_about: 3-32, the ghost, won by three burns from barrels the ghost puts back itself, each set off by a fire diamond's fireball (planning step 117).

Re-timed for the wave 3a timing build (CK, G10, G4): the walk is 2.4 u a tick, a shot takes 1 + (D - 27.2) / 3.2 ticks, the next tap waits for it to land and for the 400 ms (26 ticks), and a held fire diamond turns every tap into a fireball, so a portal can only be shot with the diamond drained (the gutter's steam, x 242, drains it).

A portal above the diamond (tap 1, lands 89) and one at the player (tap 2, 91) put the player on the double block with it; off the block to the right, a fireball at the black knight (tap 3, burned on 309): its death adds the ghost (R4), whose SHOOTING beats come on 547 and every 187.5 ticks after (735, 922, ...) and restock the barrel at barrel_spawn (190, 110) and the drained diamond.

The ghost shoots, on a beat, only at a player right of its red line (x 262); the player is left of it on every beat but one a cycle, when he stands at x 498 and the shot, fired on the beat, needs 32 ticks to reach him: he is gone through the portal pair by then.

Each cycle: a portal at (590, 190), shot from x 376 or more (the view must show it), and one over the barrel (cycle 1: (190, 182) while the barrel falls, lands 562; cycles 2-3: (214, 205) beside the resting barrel, 22 u from its centre, which carries it through) send the barrel out beside the ghost, where it rests at (590, 205); a portal at (370, 100), shot from x 491 or more (the line then clears the double block's corner), and one at the player just after the next beat put the player on the block (738, 1714, 2690), where he takes the diamond; the fireball from (399.6, 122.5) toward (514, 172) passes the ghost and burns the barrel: blasts on 866, 1842 and 2818 - hp 2, 1, 0.

After the first two, rage calls an escort onto the block (252 ticks after the blast) and a fireball from the same place at (418, 138) burns it (1148, 2124); the player walks off the block to the left, through the steam (the diamond drained), and the beat 188 ticks after the burn restocks both; he waits left of the line through it (1336, 2312), and walks back to x 376 for the first portal.

Dead, the ghost drops the yellow key at (488, 147) on 3041 (222 ticks after the third blast): a portal at the key and one at the player (3078, the key held on 3081) take the player to it, then left to the keyhole (3275), the locked door goes on 3325, and the door: won on tick 3358.
